hero.title: Earn Matsumoto Points
hero.subtitle: Register free, tap Mine once every 24 hours, and grow your rate with boosters and invites. Points convert to on-chain $Matsumoto and pay out to your BNB Chain wallet.
hero.honesty: Mining here is scheduled reward accrual, not physical hardware. Points are internal units — only $Matsumoto withdrawals settle on-chain.

chain.tagline: Secure · Transparent · You own your rewards

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Four steps from signup to payout.

register.title: Register free
register.body: Email and password. No deposit needed to start earning at the base rate.

mine.title: Tap Mine daily
mine.body: One tap every 24 hours keeps your accrual running. Miss it and the window pauses.

boost.title: Boost and invite
boost.body: Boosters raise your hourly rate for 30 days and stack. Invites raise your multiplier up to ×8.

withdraw.title: Withdraw on-chain
withdraw.body: Convert points to $Matsumoto at 3:1 and receive them at your BNB Chain address.

boosters.title: Booster packages
boosters.subtitle: Paid boosters add to your hourly rate. Stack as many as you like.

referrals.title: Referral tiers
referrals.subtitle: The more people you invite, the higher your mining multiplier.

tasksSection.title: Earn more with tasks
tasksSection.subtitle: Complete social and engagement tasks for extra points.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawal rules
withdrawals.subtitle: Clear and documented — no hidden gates.

minimum.title: 100 points minimum
minimum.body: Requests below 100 Matsumoto Points are not accepted.

frequency.title: One request per week
frequency.body: Each account can submit a single withdrawal request every 7 days.

kyc.title: KYC required
kyc.body: Verification must be approved before your first payout, for fair distribution.

approval.title: Admin review
approval.body: Every payout is reviewed before the on-chain transfer is executed.

cta.title: Start earning today
cta.body: Free to join, and you earn at the base rate from your very first tap.

footer.disclaimer: Matsumoto is a reward-simulation platform: "mining" is scheduled point accrual, not proof-of-work hardware. Points hold no value until they are converted and withdrawn as $Matsumoto on BNB Chain, subject to KYC and review.
